title: ageratina triniona
intro: Ageratina triniona, commonly known as 'Mexican Cucumber Tree' or 'Cascabela', is a plant species in the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to support digestive health and alleviate various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina triniona include its antispasmodic and anti-diarrheal effects, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
